headline: No goals in five games, and Kasımpaşa are the clear favourites
summary: Eyüpspor are 18th of 18 in the Süper Lig, with 3 points from 8 games and a goal difference of -20. They have lost 5 in a row without scoring, and on 12 October Göztepe won 0-4 at their ground. Kasımpaşa are the visitors on Saturday: 7th on 13 points, after a 4-1 home win over Samsunspor on 18 October. The market makes them 60.6% favourites, against Eyüpspor's 15.9%, and the handicap rates them 0.92 goals the better side. With Eyüpspor not scoring, Over 2.5 goals is only 47%.
read: Eyüpspor are bottom of the Süper Lig with five straight defeats and no goals scored in any of them, and they host a Kasımpaşa side that has just beaten Samsunspor 4-1 and sits seventh. The market makes Kasımpaşa about 60% favourites and rates them roughly a goal the better side, while the total line of 2.39 suggests the goals may not flow freely.

facts.fact: Eyüpspor have lost their last five Süper Lig matches and have not scored a single goal in any of them.
facts.meaning: The bottom side goes into this with no attacking return to fall back on, which is why they start as big underdogs at home.

facts.fact: Eyüpspor are 18th of 18 in the Süper Lig with 3 points from 8 games and a goal difference of -20.
facts.meaning: They are cut adrift at the bottom, which frames this as a home game against a side with far more to play for in the table.

facts.fact: Kasımpaşa are 60.6% to win away at Eyüpspor, who are 15.9% — almost four times the home side's chance.
facts.meaning: The market sees a clear away favourite rather than a close game in Istanbul.

facts.fact: Kasımpaşa beat Samsunspor 4-1 at home on 18 October and sit 7th on 13 points with a WLDWD run.
facts.meaning: Emre Belözoğlu's side arrive on the back of their biggest scoring afternoon of the run, with two wins and two draws in five.

facts.fact: The handicap fair line is 0.92 in Eyüpspor's favour on the home line, so Kasımpaşa are rated roughly a goal better on neutral ground.
facts.meaning: The market expects a one-goal away win to be about a coin flip — Eyüpspor +1 is the main line and is priced near even money.

facts.fact: Over 2.5 goals is priced at 47.0%, with the total fair line at 2.39 — the market leans just under three goals.
facts.meaning: This is not expected to be a high-scoring game despite the 4-1 last time out for Kasımpaşa.

facts.fact: Eyüpspor +1 on the handicap moved from 50.6% to 52.6% in recent days, while Kasımpaşa -1 drifted the other way.
facts.meaning: A small amount of support arrived for the home side with a one-goal start, even as the overall picture stayed firmly in Kasımpaşa's favour.

facts.fact: Eyüpspor's Y. Barasi is listed as doubtful with an injury, having played 293 minutes across 8 appearances this season.
facts.meaning: Their most-used listed attacker is a doubt for a team that has not scored in five games, so the forward line may be even thinner.

sources.fact: Eyüpspor lost 4-0 away to Göztepe after the international break, according to Haberler.
Eyüpspor lost 2-0 at home to Erzurumspor on October 17, 2026.
Kasımpaşa are coached by Emre Belözoğlu.
Kasımpaşa beat Samsunspor 4-1 at home on Matchday 8, a result that took them to 13 points.
Kasımpaşa extended their unbeaten home run with the 4-1 win over Samsunspor, according to Fanatik.
Jesurun Rak-Sakyi, on loan from Crystal Palace, impressed for Kasımpaşa, according to Read Crystal Palace.
